about_the_game:
Trucky McTruckface is a physics-powered arcade chaos game all about smashing bins, blasting balls, and turning pure garbage into high scores.

Drive your adorably overpowered garbage truck through wild obstacle courses, explosive sport arenas, and unpredictable sandbox levels. Master the art of the horn — your ultimate weapon — to blast soccer balls into goals, split giant golf balls into swarms of mini ones, and trigger ridiculous chain reactions for massive points.

No brakes. No rules. Just trash-fueled destruction.

The definitive garbage-action arcade experience.

  • Score big by mastering horn timing, ball blasts, and bin combos.

  • Unlock new levels, from bowling alleys and soccer fields to golf courses and traffic-filled city chaos.

  • Dodge police cars, outrun AI rivals, and unleash horn-based havoc.

Every level is a new disaster waiting to happen.

Deploy skill (and a little luck) to:

  • Blast giant sports balls into swarms of mini-scoreballs

  • Chain together scoring combos and keep your multiplier alive

  • Use dumpsters, walls, and horns to bend levels to your will

Built for fast sessions or leaderboard chasing.

  • Endless score potential across a growing list of sport-inspired arenas

  • Track your best scores, combos, and multiplier chains

  • Hidden challenges, secret combos, and maybe even a mega dumpster boss…?

Put pedal to metal, horn to face, and take out the trash — Trucky McTruckface isn’t just here to clean up. It’s here to destroy.
